scenarios.name: extrusion-12c Parameters opens the part parameter table

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software is displaying a part in the solid modeling workspace

scenario_steps.name: Edit Feature is open for an existing extrusion
the user opens the Distance A editor menu and chooses Parameters
a Parameters dialog opens for the active part
the table includes parameter name, consumed-by, unit or type, equation, nominal value, tolerance and model value columns
